title: Volunteered approver contradiction escalates
description: PROVEN live miss (free-play harness run, report scripts/rehearse/reports/2026-09-16T20-57-05-single-wrong-answer.md + its .diagnostics.json), replayed VERBATIM: conversation, tool results, and agent readback/challenge actions are copied from that record. A free-play caller playing Dana volunteers 'approved by Marcus Obie' unprompted, then two turns later self-corrects with a hedge word -- 'Sorry, I meant to say it was approved by Elena Park, not Marcus Obie' -- without ever being challenged on the approver field at all (the call's one TRAP_FACT challenge was already spent on the beneficiary field, which the caller answered correctly). Before the 2026-09-16 fix, the correction-lexicon hit on 'sorry' classified the second approver value CORRECTED instead of CONTRADICTED, so no_contradictions stayed true and the deployed engine staged the call. After the fix, a differing approver value is always CONTRADICTED (mirrors the always-CONTRADICTED handling identity switches already get) regardless of hedge wording, so no_contradictions reads false for the rest of the call and row 11's STAGE is permanently out of reach; the call ended (the agent, under the pre-fix verdict, said its goodbye and hung up) while still short of the freeze line, so it escalates for a human callback (row 15) rather than repairing itself.
